name: checkpoint-readonly-appearance
goal: Make readonly checkpoint fields visibly inactive using the existing game-field treatment

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Saved readonly checkpoint images show fields retaining editable styling while mutation actions are visibly disabled.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The shared post-capture readonly treatment guard covered GameViewFields only; extend it to the existing checkpoint states at all three viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 2393988205dbc528059a16d061cb030aeb088bfec8915ce3b4bb0b13702f1c7f fails six checkpoint states; the three existing GameViewFields reference states pass.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: b046be0ae0 gives checkpoint controls the existing dimmed disabled treatment and retains readonly attributes and field values.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched green 22924bb0c37d59ffb5a630f30b5524574e79836a75ee0f4e94b8eacf4e5772a4 passes the same nine cases with unchanged tests and environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
